notes: The exact mappings below follow the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. The test obtains valid dimension and class handles from an adapter-supplied dimensional FOM before resignation, then checks the membership exception after resignation with the connection still open.

requirements.statement: The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getAvailableDimensionsForObjectClass. The test supplies a valid object-class handle from the adapter FOM and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getAvailableDimensionsForInteractionClass. The test supplies a valid interaction-class handle from the adapter FOM and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getDimensionName. The test supplies a valid dimension handle from the adapter FOM and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getDimensionUpperBound. The test supplies a valid dimension handle from the adapter FOM and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.
